preconditions.expression: isinstance(words, list) and all(isinstance(word, str) for word in words)
preconditions.description: The input must be a list of strings.
Each word in the list must consist only of alphabet characters.
Each word in the list must have at least one character.

postconditions.description: The output list must have the same length as the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(count, int) and count >= 0 for count in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(count == sum(1 for i, c in enumerate(word.lower(), 1) if ord(c) - ord('a') + 1 == i) for word, count in zip(words, stdout))
postconditions.description: Each count in the output list must represent the number of letters in the corresponding word that occupy their positions in the alphabet.
